title: Targeted Render Revision Request
description: The decision payload for resolve_final_video_approval() when decision=revision_requested. target_scene_ids empty/omitted means the whole video needs rework; a non-empty list identifies the scenes the reviewer flagged. See docs/architecture/video-render-pipeline.md#revision-handling.

target_scene_ids.description: Empty/omitted = revise the whole video. Non-empty = the reviewer-identified scenes needing rework (visual shot, overlay text, caption style, audio mix, transition, branding, or attribution category — see docs/architecture/video-render-pipeline.md#revision-handling).
